rationale: Price has collapsed from the session high of $9.68 all the way to the exact day low at $6.05, sitting at 0% of today's range — a short at the low carries severe snap-back risk on a 0.81M float name. The 347 bps bid/ask spread ($6.05/$6.26) alone consumes any near-term edge on a small ATR instrument, and with no news catalyst to explain or sustain the move, direction is unpredictable. Given the already negative daily P&L and the extreme illiquidity cost, the risk-adjusted case for either direction is insufficient to justify capital commitment.
